notes: Route-specific groups: where WHO classifies the oral and injectable forms differently (fosfomycin, minocycline), "aware" gives both, as {"O": ..., "P": ...}.
DDDs are WHO values in grams per day (dddUnit "MU" = million units) for the oral (O) and parenteral (P) routes; inhaled and rectal DDDs are not used by the tools.
For beta-lactamase-inhibitor combinations the WHO DDD refers to one component (dddRefersTo).
Fixed-dose combinations in "notRecommended" are WHO "Not recommended"; any antibacterial combination not listed at all is also treated as Not recommended by AMS Pro.
First published edition: WHO AWaRe 2025 (including the 2025 additions such as aztreonam-avibactam, gepotidacin and benzathine phenoxymethylpenicillin) and WHO ATC/DDD Index 2026.
